subQuests.subQuestName: Take in the view outside of Liyue Harbor to collect your thoughts

20000201.text: #Are you okay? Paimon never imagined your {F#brother}{M#sister} would have sided with the Abyss...

20000205.text: Paimon believes in both of you.

20000206.text: And when the going gets tough, the tough get going! Right?

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask Atsuko about how to travel to Inazuma

20000301.text: Hello... Oh! I—I mean, good fortune... right? *sigh* I'm still learning to talk like a local, haha...

20000302.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

20000303.text: We wanted to ask... how do we get into Inazuma?

20000304.text: Ohh, so that's why you're here... Well, there is a way...

20000305.text: Great! We came to the right person!

20000306.text: But the chance of success is... incredibly small.

20000307.text: Huh? Incredibly small? Then how did you get out of Inazuma in the first place?

20000308.text: It was in leaving Inazuma that I found out just how dangerous this method truly was...

20000309.text: All I had to rely on was a little wooden raft that I'd put together myself. There was a storm raging ahead of me, and my pursuers were close on my tail.

20000310.text: After I'd escaped their clutches, I floated on the open ocean for... I don't know how many days. My rations and fresh water supply soon ran out, and I remember getting to the point where I was sure I'd reached the end. Then, I blacked out.

20000311.text: But, to my surprise, my journey didn't end there... or to put it another way, a new beginning found me.

20000312.text: Did someone from Liyue save you?

20000313.text: That's right! I escaped by the skin of my teeth. The fact that I'm even alive to tell the tale must be a sign that the gods were watching over me.

20000314.text: What a horrible journey! And you set off knowing how dangerous it was? Why?

20000315.text: Well... because everything is just too restrictive over there. The atmosphere is so stifling... The Kanjou Commission subjects everyone leaving or entering the nation to a protracted approval process, and... I felt like I didn't belong there.

20000317.text: Along with the other two commissions, they oversee everything in Inazuma. We usually collectively refer to them as the Tri-Commission — I suppose they're equivalent to the Eight Trades under the Liyue Qixing.

20000318.text: One of the obligations of the Kanjou Commission is to conduct rigorous identity checks on all individuals leaving or entering Inazuma. All non-nationals are processed centrally on Ritou upon arrival...

20000319.text: Meanwhile, the Tenryou Commission is responsible for implementing the recently promulgated Vision Hunt Decree. They act like the executive arm of the Raiden Shogun's rule, loyal yet unfeeling.

20000320.text: It doesn't feel good to speak ill of my home like this... but after spending so long under that oppressive atmosphere, I began to lose all hope for the future.

20000321.text: What I mean to say is... unless you have an extremely compelling reason to go to Inazuma, you should abandon your plans of trying to get there.

20000324.text: *sigh* You should know that the sea around Inazuma is engulfed in a perpetual tempest of wind and rain. Supposing you survived that, you would still need to get past the samurai guards that enforce the Sakoku Decree — the closed nation policy of Inazuma.

20000325.text: And even if you did manage to find a way, you'd still have to produce the necessary documentation at the Ritou center for processing outlanders. Otherwise, you'd be kicked out immediately...

20000326.text: Seems like they really don't want anyone setting foot in Inazuma, huh...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to The Alcor and meet with Beidou

20000401.text: #Hmm? Who've we got here... Wait, I know you. You're that traveler, {NICKNAME}, aren't you? The one who fought against the Fatui and Osial, right?

20000404.text: Haha, Ningguang told me about you. "A traveler of great insight and remarkable skill has saved Liyue," she said.

20000405.text: She's a hard one to please... so praise from her is high praise indeed. I remember thinking at the time that it'd be good to meet you in person.

20000406.text: Judging by the clothes on your back and this floating thing, I guess that time has come.

20000407.text: Hey! The name's not "floating thing," it's PAIMON!

20000408.text: Paimon... hmm... What a fascinating being. You two give off not only the essence of wind and earth, but also of... yes... the stars...

20000409.text: Eh? The fragrance of what now? That's the weirdest compliment Paimon's ever heard...

20000410.text: Pay it no heed... I mean only to say I am certain... that it is by fate, not chance alone, that we should meet... and that gives our encounter meaning.

20000501.text: Hello, are you here to compete in The Crux Clash?

20000502.text: You bet I am, have you put your names down yet?

20000505.text: Well, I'd have a look at the entrance criteria if I were you. They don't allow just anyone to take part.

20000506.text: The Clash is a comprehensive test of fighting ability. Anyone who turns up for show over skill is gonna get their butt handed to them.

20000507.text: Tsk, nobody wants to see that, right?

20000508.text: Yeah, we heard a rule about that. So Paimon's wondering... are you a renowned fighter?

20000509.text: Hahaha, me? Only a former runner-up in the Chihu Rock Freestyle Combat Summit! Oh yeah...

20000601.text: Hi there, are you here for The Crux Clash too?

20000602.text: That's right. Nothing beats real-life combat for honing your skills. That's what our master taught us.

20000603.text: But this tournament is more than just a chance to put training into practice — it's also a chance for us to obtain the Masterless Vision.

20000604.text: Exactly! With a Vision, we'd quickly become our master's top students.

20000605.text: This master of yours must be pretty incredible, huh... Are they someone famous?

20000606.text: Famous? He's the founder of the Lingshan Clan, and his skills are unparalleled! Liang and I are both proud disciples of his.

20000609.text: You probably wouldn't have heard of it, it was founded quite recently. The clan is nowhere near as famous as the master himself, anyway.

20000610.text: He's got to be a grandmaster or something. He's created many different styles of kung fu, and countless other clans have borrowed extensively from him.

20000611.text: To the Lingshan Clan, he teaches a special technique known as "force dispersal."

20000613.text: It's a type of breathing exercise where you can train yourself to harness the energy around you and neutralize attacks without moving an inch.

20000614.text: For example, our master can use it to alter the path of an attacking fist, or change the direction of an incoming stone, all without breaking a sweat!

20000615.text: One time, he sent a challenger flying into the air without lifting a finger!

20000617.text: It sure is! But it's extremely difficult to cultivate this ability. We've been training for ages, and we're still getting to grips with the very basics. There's no way we could use it proficiently yet.

20000618.text: *sigh* We're clearly not that naturally gifted, or we would have at least gotten the gist by now... If we don't start making progress soon, we'll probably run out of money to pay the tuition fees and still have nothing to show for all our training...

20000620.text: Of course! This is a grandmaster we're talking about here. He doesn't have time to waste. If you want face-to-face training, you've gotta show you're sincere about it.

20000621.text: *sigh* But here we are, having trained under him directly all this time without even a hint of improvement. Master is getting increasingly impatient with us.

20000622.text: Recently, though, we heard that a Vision bearer joined the Guhua Clan and made pretty much instant progress in their training.

20000623.text: So, if we can get our hands on a Vision, too, maybe we can finally make our master proud!

20000701.text: Hey, youngster. Are you here for The Crux Clash too?

20000702.text: If so... seems I've found myself another new adversary.

20000703.text: So you're also here for the tournament?

20000704.text: You better believe it. I wouldn't be here if I didn't think I could walk away as a champion.

20000705.text: For me, obtaining a Vision is the final and most important piece in the puzzle that is my life.

20000708.text: No, no, no — it's not about what I want to do. This is about who I want to be. I am looking to become a perfect person.

20000709.text: I know how that sounds, but let me explain. I've lived a successful life so far, without any setbacks.

20000710.text: I've passed every exam I've ever taken, enjoyed numerous successful business ventures, and seem to get on with just about everyone socially...

20000711.text: In most people's eyes, I am already the very embodiment of the perfect person, though of course, I'd never let the praise get to my head. I know I haven't reached perfection yet... because there's one thing I'm still missing...

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Zhuhan, who is in charge of registration for The Crux Clash

20001001.text: Qingce Village Armwrestling Champion, huh... *sigh* Alright, you're signed up...

20001007.text: ...Huh? Aren't they a Vision bearer, though? Why are they trying to enter The Clash?

20001008.text: Uh... I—I have to ask... aren't you the traveler that helped Liyue fight off that ancient god...?

20001011.text: The one that spoke with Lady Keqing at the Rite of Parting!

20001012.text: #Oh! Oh! I wonder if I can get {F#her}{M#his} autograph later?

20001013.text: I—I trust you are aware that... only those without Visions can enter the tournament?

20001015.text: Really? B—But from what I've heard, the things you're capable of in combat are... nothing short of extraordinary... You walk into the most dangerous situations imaginable, face off against all sorts of monsters — even the Fatui — and always come out on top!

20001016.text: #Yup! {F#She}{M#He} still doesn't have a Vision though. See for yourself!

20001017.text: My apologies, I didn't mean to be rude. I'm sure a great hero like yourself would have no reason to lie. Now, could I ask you to provide a few claims to fame?

20001018.text: It's just a formality for you, of course, but I have to make a record of competitors' achievements as part of the sign-up process...

20001019.text: So far I've got "Defeated the ancient god, Osial," so that's one. Do you... have any others?

20001021.text: Yeah, and also a dragon, too! Put down "Battle with Stormterror"!

20001027.text: #Might as well declare {F#her}{M#him} the champion already.

20001028.text: I wonder if it's too late to withdraw?

20001029.text: Okay, um... that's plenty... Actually, this is the most dazzling track record I've ever seen, by a long shot...

20001030.text: Right, your registration is complete. Now, a brief word about the prize.

20001031.text: A great hero such as yourself can surely only be here for one thing — to win the tournament and claim the grand prize, namely, a Vision.

20001032.text: Oh, we're not here for that. We're here because Captain Beidou promised to take us to Inazuma if we win the tournament.

20001033.text: There's another prize too? First I've heard of it!

20001034.text: Beidou must have upped the stakes this time to attract top talent!

20001035.text: But why would anyone want to go somewhere as dangerous as Inazuma?

20001036.text: ...I see, so... I take it you discussed your terms with Beidou in advance, then.

20001023.text: Yeah, put that down! And also, "Defeated the Fatui Harbinger, Childe."

20001025.text: Yeah! Also, don't forget to mention that previous battles include, but are not limited to "Stormterror" Dvalin and Fatui Harbinger, Childe.

20002001.text: Best of luck to you in your journey to Inazuma.

20002002.text: Oh, and if you do actually make it to Inazuma, please be sure not to mention my name to anyone there.

20002101.text: Go on, get yourself to Guyun and sign up already.

20002102.text: I've already fixed up the arena. You can't miss it.

20002201.text: Martial arts tournaments always remind me of the duels they have back in Inazuma...

20002202.text: But when the combatants are obliged to exercise restraint, it is unlikely they will ever display their true potential.

20002602.text: I knew you guys would come, hahaha!

20009903.text: So to recap... we're up against an inflated ego, some gullible guys paying way too much for their kung fu classes, and another guy who's just... really average.

20009904.text: #Hmm... Seems like you've got a pretty good chance of winning this thing, {NICKNAME}!
